items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: the fellas up there, like Kewley and them fellas, were using the A and B clarinet.

ctx.x: Which Teal was this? Lorenzo. Is that the old man or the young one? No, the young fellow.

Well, they were all great, all three of them. His daddy was the clarinet and his uncle was the clarinet player, see? And he was the youngest. Well, he took a B clarinet and he played everything, because he knew the transposition, you see? But he was an ace musician, you see? He went to Chicago and the fellas up there, like Kewley and them fellas, were using the A and B clarinet. And when he sat down and played with that B clarinet, they wondered how he was doing it, you see? Well, he started the transposition,…
